title: Jurat
summary: JU'RAT, noun [Latin juratus, sworn, from juro, to swear.] In England, a magistrate in some corporations; an alderman, or an assistant to a bailiff.

inlines.v: JU'RAT, noun [Latin juratus, sworn, from juro, to swear.] In England, a magistrate in some corporations; an alderman, or an assistant to a bailiff.
